items.title: Refining a one step devissage along an elementary etale neighbourhood of the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma must upgrade a one step devissage (Z, Y, i, pi, G, z, y) of F/X/S at x, after an arbitrary elementary etale neighbourhood (Y', y') -> (Y, y) -> (S, s), into a fresh one step devissage of the pullback F'' on a newly manufactured X'' together with an open Y'' of Y' x_{S'} S'' and Z'' = Z x_Y Y'' (statement lines 1049-1062). The proof manufactures X'' by applying the etale lifting lemma to the composite Z'' -> Z_{S''} -> X_{S''} so that Z'' = X'' x_{X_{S'}} Z_{S'} while keeping X'' affine, and then verifies every clause of the definition except one (proof lines 1065-1110). The clause that does not follow from the construction is geometric irreducibility of the fibres of Y'' -> S'', and the proof repairs exactly that: it takes the irreducible component T of Y'_{s'} through y', converts kappa(s) algebraically closed in kappa(y) into geometric connectedness of T and smoothness of T into geometric irreducibility, and only then invokes the normal-morphism lemma for the final elementary etale (S'', s'') -> (S', s'') with all fibres geometrically irreducible (proof lines 1112-1133). The same passage also has to preserve pi'' finite with pi''^{-1}({y''}) = {z''} and the dimension n of the support in the fibre, both checked through residue-field equalities and etale invariance of dimension at a point.
